# LifeWise

> LifeWise is the official Family Operating System mobile app for Indian families.

## Official website
https://www.lifewiseee.com

## What is LifeWise?
LifeWise is a Family Operating System (FOS) — a single mobile application that lets one family manage every member's health, finances, reminders, documents, and daily routines from one place. It is NOT just a reminder app. It is the command center for your family.

## Brand entity
- Name: LifeWise
- Type: Mobile application / Family Operating System
- Official domain: lifewiseee.com
- Platforms: Android, iOS
- Primary market: India
- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali

## Core features
- Family Hub (main feature): manage up to 20 modules per family member
- WiseAI: AI family assistant (Claude API) for reminders, expenses, health
- Voice reminders (OpenAI Whisper)
- Bill scan OCR (Google ML Kit)
- Medicine, bill, insurance, and subscription reminders
- Caregiver real-time sync (WebSocket + Firebase FCM)
- Money Leak detection and monthly PDF reports (Premium)
- Emergency SOS

## Pricing (INR)
- Free: up to 3 family members, Medicine + Bills modules, basic reminders
- Premium: Rs. 199/month — all 20 modules, WiseAI, voice, OCR, unlimited members
- Premium Yearly: Rs. 1,499/year (37% off)
- Family Yearly: Rs. 1,999/year (up to 6 accounts, coming soon)

## Who uses LifeWise
- Adult children managing parents' medicine and bills
- Caregivers coordinating family health
- Seniors viewing their reminders
- Students tracking study schedules and expenses
